question: Should maintainers accept this PR's `operator.read` `sessions.search` method, default `sessions_search` tool, and query-time FTS reconcile lifecycle as the landing implementation, or choose the open maintainer-authored event-driven alternative once it is clean?
rationale: The change exposes searchable persisted transcript content through a new default core API and persisted index, and there is now a competing maintainer-authored implementation with a different index lifecycle; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary or landing branch safely.

options.title: Choose Landing Path First
options.body: Keep this PR open while a maintainer decides whether this branch or the open maintainer-authored alternative should become the canonical implementation.

options.title: Approve This PR Boundary
options.body: Accept the current `operator.read` scope, visibility filtering, redacted snippets, and query-time reconcile lifecycle as the intended v1 contract.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer Search
options.body: Require a stricter scope, target model, or delayed product direction before any default core transcript-search surface lands.

recommendation.title: Choose Landing Path First
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open while a maintainer decides whether this branch or the open maintainer-authored alternative should become the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the canonical feature request and authored the overlapping maintainer alternative, making them the clearest owner for the product/security boundary and landing-path choice.
